The derivative -∂_r normalized resolvent has positive hyperbolic form for every distance n≠0; the small-r finite-N asymptotics give both macroscopic order N^-1 and wall order N^-2 coefficients. Exact rational full-state tests at N=3,4 independently corroborate normalization and rates. Limits are analytically proved, not deduced from finite computations.

value.rationale: It resolves whether persistent site-specific reset memory raises or lowers stationary spin correlations relative to freshly randomized noise at matched per-site rates for every finite cycle and every positive rate; it also quantifies the first detectable memory effect when the leading critical finite-size profile is identical. These are motivated questions about persistence of quenched information and finite-volume domain walls, not arbitrary parameter substitutions.
